recommendations.plain_english_explanation: FixList found 38 missing tags across 38 product pages. These URLs use the same page pattern, so repair the shared metadata output instead of editing every URL separately.
recommendations.plain_english_summary: FixList found 38 missing tags across 38 product pages. These URLs use the same page pattern, so repair the shared metadata output instead of editing every URL separately.
recommendations.why_it_matters: Meta descriptions can appear beneath page titles in search results. Missing, empty, or malformed output leaves search engines to create their own snippet, which can be less specific or persuasive. Fixing the shared template improves the whole affected group.
recommendations.recommended_value: Repair the shared metadata template so every affected page outputs exactly one non-empty, page-specific, plain-text meta description, with a reliable fallback when the dedicated SEO field is blank.
